title: Fizza ne kaha auno mohammed gaye maare
body:
fizza ne kaha auno mohammed gaye maare, darya ke kanaare
mamau pe fida hogaye zainab ke dulaare, darya ke kanaare
sun kar ye sada saaniye zahra ye pukaari, amma gayi waari
aate hi mere laadle dunya se sidhaare, darya ke kanaare
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhenge na pani ki taraf aankh uthaake, waada tha ye maa se
shehzado ne dam tod diya pyaas ke maare, darya ke kanaare
maqtal ke andhero me the us ghar ke ujaale, do phool se pyaare
ye chaand ke tukde hai ke toote hue taare, darya ke kanaare
